) JOIN digital_qa_ppt_finding previous_finding ON previous_finding.id=r.finding_id WHERE f.id=#{id} AND f.status <> 'DELETED' AND r.assignment_revision=previous_finding.assignment_revision AND length() > 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM digital_qa_ppt_material_version newer WHERE newer.batch_id=v.batch_id AND newer.status='ANALYZED' AND newer.version_no > prior.version_no AND newer.version_no < v.version_no ) ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: WITH inherit_findings AS ( SELECT f.id, f.version_id, v.batch_id, v.version_no, v.status AS version_status, f.chapter, f.feedback_department, f.auto_departments, f.status, f.assignment_revision, AS title_key FROM digital_qa_ppt_finding f JOIN digital_qa_ppt_material_version v ON v.id=f.version_id WHERE f.status <> 'DELETED' ), inherit_matches AS ( SELECT f.id AS finding_id, f.version_id, p.id AS prior_id, p.version_id AS prior_version_id, p.version_no, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY f.id, p.version_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN f.chapter=p.chapter THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS preference FROM inherit_findings f JOIN inherit_findings p ON p.batch_id=f.batch_id AND p.version_no<f.version_no AND p.version_status='ANALYZED' AND p.title_key=f.title_key AND (f.feedback_department=p.feedback_department OR (f.feedback_department IS NULL AND p.feedback_department IS NULL AND f.auto_departments=p.auto_departments) OR (p.feedback_department IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM digital_qa_ppt_finding_recipient prior_recipient JOIN digital_qa_ppt_finding_recipient current_recipient ON current_recipient.user_id=prior_recipient.user_id WHERE prior_recipient.finding_id=p.id AND current_recipient.finding_id=f.id ))) WHERE f.version_id=#{id} AND length(f.title_key) > 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM digital_qa_ppt_material_version newer WHERE newer.batch_id=f.batch_id AND newer.status='ANALYZED' AND newer.version_no > p.version_no AND newer.version_no < f.version_no ) ), inherit_candidates AS ( SELECT inherit_matches.*, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY finding_id, prior_version_id) AS candidate_count, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY prior_id, version_id) AS destination_count FROM inherit_matches WHERE preference=1 ), inherit_notes AS ( SELECT c.finding_id, current_finding.assignment_revision, r.judgement, r.adjusted_departments, r.explanation, r.user_id, r.created_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.finding_id ORDER BY c.version_no DESC, r.id DESC) AS priority FROM inherit_candidates c JOIN inherit_findings prior_finding ON prior_finding.id=c.prior_id JOIN inherit_findings current_finding ON current_finding.id=c.finding_id JOIN digital_qa_ppt_finding_feedback r ON r.finding_id=c.prior_id AND r.assignment_revision=prior_finding.assignment_revision WHERE c.candidate_count=1 AND c.destination_count=1 AND prior_finding.status IN ('CONFIRMED','ADJUSTED') AND current_finding.status='PENDING_FEEDBACK' AND current_finding.assignment_revision=0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM digital_qa_ppt_finding_recipient h WHERE h.finding_id=c.finding_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM digital_qa_ppt_finding_feedback own WHERE own.finding_id=c.finding_id) ) INSERT INTO digital_qa_ppt_finding_feedback(finding_id,judgement,adjusted_departments,explanation,user_id,created_at,assignment_revision) SELECT finding_id,judgement,adjusted_departments,explanation,user_id,created_at,assignment_revision FROM inherit_notes WHERE priority=1
